name: idc-psma-pet-ct-lesions
description: 597 whole-body PSMA-PET/CT studies from 378 male patients with suspected or diagnosed prostate carcinoma, acquired at LMU University Hospital Munich (2014-2022). All PSMA-avid tumor lesions were manually segmented on PET images in 3D. The dataset includes DICOM images, DICOM SEG segmentation masks, and a TSV metadata file. Used in the autoPET III and IV Grand Challenges. Please see the PSMA-PET-CT-Lesions page to learn more about the images and to obtain any supporting metadata for this collection.

recordSet.name: Clinical variables with measured completeness
recordSet.description: Completeness is measured from the source repository's own records. A field populated entirely with non-answers is reported as populated but not informative, because it blocks an analysis just as surely as an absent field.
